tasks.title: Deliver and qualify one Workspace across Settings, tasks and Notes
tasks.body:
Goal:
- Complete the owner journey: browser default, explicit cloud adoption and automatic new-session restoration across Settings, Todo routes and Notes.

Current behavior:
- Settings repeats per-tab consent/renewal; Todo lists independent sources and Notes has a separate selector. The current message is "Choose the exact workspace. Browser and cloud records remain independent."

Desired behavior:
- Consume shared verified source/recovery state. Show one ordinary Workspace; local first use needs no source setup. Cloud choice discloses credential/task/Notes effects, reviews transfer and removes the browser option after verified acceptance. Frozen local recovery copies are not ordinary sources.
- Restore exact selected Workspace and approved integration/Notes settings in new sessions without repeated consent checkboxes. Separate actual server state from new acknowledgements; show unavailable/disconnected/revoked/migration-pending states without writable fallback.
- Replace contradictory copy across Settings, Todo Sync, task/project routes and Notes. Preserve private drafts, original-command recovery, conflicts and account changes. Expose progress, record counts and original-transfer recovery; reference the shipped MCP parity contract.
- Keep export and explicit pause/disconnect available. Do not advertise a cloud-to-browser move: reverse transfer needs a separate ownership protocol and remains deferred.

Touch:
- SettingsPage, WorkspaceSettingsPanel, NotesPanel, Todo source disclosures and affected route orchestration; existing real-Razor component and rendered browser fixtures.

Discovery allowance:
- Enumerate every affected route/state and inspect consumers of the shared source/controllers before changing shared UI.

Out of scope:
- Reverse transfer, physical-device/assistive-technology operation, new production enrollment, publication and unrelated redesign.

Implementation constraints:
- Route entry/source restoration cannot enroll, enable execution or mutate Habitica. Required predecessor outcomes precede final qualification. Preserve primary task/note actions and accessible recovery.

Questions and required clarifications:
- [Resolved - owner intent] One Workspace is the ordinary model. Cloud adoption moves browser records and hides the browser choice; optional simple return was assessed as a separate ownership protocol rather than a source toggle.

Validation:
- Component interactions cover first use, cloud review/accept, populated-target conflicts, cancellation, dirty drafts, response loss/reload, new sessions, offline/revoked/expired status and account switching. Run all changed routes in readable built-in light and dark Obsidian Glow at documented phone/desktop widths with normal/200-percent text, visible focus/primary actions, disabled controls, geometry and contrast.

Acceptance:
- A synthetic end-to-end journey preserves task/Notes records and selected source through adoption/restart. All changed routes expose one active Workspace with original recovery; browser selection disappears only after verified transfer. Required interactions and rendered checks pass; device/host gaps remain explicit.

Documentation updates:
- Update ux-ui-manifest.md, features.md, technical.md, testing.md and user-facing privacy/source copy with the single-Workspace behavior and deferred reverse-transfer limits.

Risks:
- Rendering alone cannot qualify session restoration or transfer safety. Local checks do not prove the affected live account or physical device.

tasks.title: Expose reviewed Workspace adoption and original-transfer recovery through MCP
tasks.body:
Goal:
- Provide reviewed MCP parity for adoption/status/recovery without granting agents browser storage or enrollment authority.

Current behavior:
- Normal task/organization/Notes tools have no complete transfer counterpart. MCP cannot read IndexedDB or verify local freeze directly.

Desired behavior:
- Audit predecessor adoption steps and add bounded exact own-profile status, owner-staged transfer preview, reviewed acceptance and original-transfer receipt tools with identical target/revision/hash/epoch/expiry guards.
- Require an immutable owner-staged artifact/transfer identity; missing browser capture remains an explicit prerequisite. Never fabricate source records, freeze evidence or uploads. Bind acceptance to reviewed bytes; recover original receipts after uncertainty/later edits.
- Require an explicitly disclosed migration-write scope and independent Notes permissions when Notes is included. Existing task/project grants cannot reveal Notes or authorize enrollment, local capture, executor activation or deletion. Return permitted counts/mappings without credentials or inaccessible content.
- Scope recovery guidance to reads and existing authority; tools cannot grant new permissions. Share server acceptance rules with the application.

Touch:
- Shared migration schemas/scopes, MCP descriptors/dispatch, Workspace private handlers, package references and protocol/parity fixtures.

Discovery allowance:
- Match every staged-artifact/status/receipt operation to the implemented server protocol and compatibility metadata conventions.

Out of scope:
- Browser automation, arbitrary filesystem/URL imports, raw API passthrough, management secret exposure, automatic enrollment, reverse transfer, real OAuth grants and publication.

Implementation constraints:
- Exact identities and current scope checks apply throughout. Preview is not acceptance; lookup creates no new intent. Preserve independent account/source/Notes guards and unknown outcomes.

Questions and required clarifications:
- [Resolved - repository rule] Agent-required steps need reviewed MCP tools. Browser-local capture is an owner prerequisite, not a grant of local storage access to MCP.

Validation:
- Run Worker/MCP schema and parity fixtures for missing migration/Notes scopes, cross-account/stale/expired transfers, changed bytes, invalid staging evidence, revocation, lost acknowledgement and original receipt reads. Assert zero enrollment and task/game effects.

Acceptance:
- Authorized agents inspect, review, accept and recover owner-staged transfers under application-equivalent guards. Missing evidence/consent remains explicit; permanent browser automation is unnecessary for agent-facing steps.

Documentation updates:
- Update discovery/tool contracts, package references, scope disclosures and testing.md with artifact preparation and installed-host limits.

Risks:
- Local schema checks cannot establish actual host discovery, grant availability or Codex/ChatGPT activation.

tasks.title: Move browser tasks and Notes into one cloud Workspace with recoverable adoption
tasks.body:
Goal:
- Move all account-owned browser records into the selected cloud Workspace through one reviewed, recoverable adoption workflow.

Current behavior:
- Local handoff freezes task journals; the server requires an empty target. Personal Notes is absent. Notes import rejects different owner scope/conflicting notebooks; links and historical command hashes retain source identities.

Desired behavior:
- Extend shared source-transition state with durable two-store freeze and a versioned staged manifest covering all selected-account local Workspaces, tasks, organization, saved views, journals/events, personal Notes, retained versions, trash/purge markers and receipts. Resolve unsaved drafts explicitly before staging.
- Review exact sources/target, revisions, hashes, counts, privacy effects and conflicts. Support populated cloud targets: preserve disjoint records and require explicit resolution of conflicting identities; never deduplicate titles or silently overwrite data. Preserve existing target canonical identity when populated; record source identity mappings.
- Retain exact source bytes, record IDs, hashes and original receipt lookup in durable provenance. Explicitly map current Note owner/source/Workspace links without rewriting historical command bytes, losing associations or fabricating task/completion/reward events. Keep retained history readable/exportable.
- Persist one immutable transfer ID/hash through staging, crashes, lost replies and acknowledgement failures. Atomic D1 acceptance commits target tasks/Notes and the original receipt; frozen local authority blocks edits/dispatch. Publish cloud selection only after verified acceptance and finish acknowledgement through original-receipt recovery.
- Fence concurrent cloud edits/leases. Preserve existing consent/settings and keep newly imported effect intents paused for separate review; migration dispatches no game effects. Refuse capacity/schema failures without truncation. Frozen local copies remain recovery evidence, outside ordinary writable sources.

Touch:
- WorkspaceHandoffService, Notes/store authority, IndexedDB cross-table transactions, WorkspaceDataController, typed transport, server handoff/Notes/journal validation and additive Workspace migrations/fixtures.

Discovery allowance:
- Inspect archival hashes, identity mapping, revision semantics and D1 limits. Extend the bounded existing protocol; do not recreate imported records through ordinary task/Notes commands.

Out of scope:
- Reverse transfer, automatic cloud deletion, initial credential/OAuth/executor consent, arbitrary import URLs, real private records, remote migration and publication.

Implementation constraints:
- Separate IndexedDB and D1 commits need a durable state machine. Uncertainty cannot create a replacement transfer ID. Private sync receives neither credentials nor raw Notes. Retain quota/schema limits unless a deliberate scoped extension is justified.

Questions and required clarifications:
- [Resolved - owner decision] Explicit cloud choice moves browser records and leaves one ordinary active cloud Workspace. Conflicts preserve data pending review. Reverse movement is deferred because restore/disconnect lacks a two-store ownership fence.

Validation:
- Synthetic .NET/IndexedDB/local Worker-D1 controls cover populated targets, multiple source Workspaces, title/ID collisions, Note project rebinding with retained history, Unicode, trash/purged records, legacy schemas, capacity, concurrent tabs/epochs/leases, rollback, restart and response loss at every transition. Prove original receipt recovery after later edits, no duplicate writable authority and zero game dispatch.

Acceptance:
- Every accepted source record remains readable with exact provenance and correct current associations in the sole target. Frozen local copies cannot mutate/execute. Refusal or uncertainty preserves data and original identity; restart recovery completes acceptance/acknowledgement without replay or replacement intent.

Documentation updates:
- Update Workspace/Notes project contracts, technical.md, features.md, testing.md and migration guidance with versioned adoption, provenance, failure and export behavior.

Risks:
- Changing historical owner/Workspace fields invalidates hashes. Large histories can exceed capacity and must remain explicitly blocked without loss.

tasks.title: Persist account settings and restore one active Workspace across sessions
tasks.body:
Goal:
- Restore account settings and one shared task/Notes source after sign-in/private sync; browser storage supplies the ordinary default.

Current behavior:
- CloudSyncSectionMapping lacks connection/source descriptors. Todo source and NotesController.Source are separate volatile state; Notes resets to Browser on account changes. Multiple local Workspaces can exist.

Desired behavior:
- Introduce versioned account-bound preferences for active source, exact store references and non-authorizing recovery metadata. Add compatible IndexedDB, portability and encrypted section-sync handling with revision/conflict/tombstone rules and legacy defaults.
- Consume existing-only recovery after eligible metadata loads, coalesce bootstrap per account and discard delayed responses after account/connection changes. Server consent/grants/executor observations remain authoritative; no temporary bearer enters preference storage.
- Select the sole eligible browser Workspace automatically or lazily create one default when none exists. Preserve all legacy stores; ambiguous multiple identities require consolidation rather than guessed ownership. Task and Notes consumers share one active source.
- Retain a recorded cloud choice during offline, expired or unavailable access; never create a writable browser fallback. Preserve dirty drafts and original-command uncertainty. Inventory affected Settings/Todo Sync/Notes controls; keep new-consent acknowledgements, codes, private drafts, notification permission and device subscriptions outside preference replay.

Touch:
- Shared application source/settings service, AppSessionController bootstrap, CloudSyncSection/Mapping, StorageKeys, account stores, typed clients, TodoWorkspacePresentation and NotesController.

Discovery allowance:
- Inspect sync merge/exclusion and private-data lifetime rules under current schemas/package pins; use the predecessor recovery contract.

Out of scope:
- Moving records to cloud, reverse transfer, new consent/executor opt-in, syncing device permissions, real account calls and publication.

Implementation constraints:
- A local consent boolean cannot authorize remote writes/recovery. Missing cloud data never silently downgrades the source. Account changes clear private observations and in-memory access without erasing unrelated account preferences.

Questions and required clarifications:
- [Resolved - owner decision] Browser is the default before explicit cloud selection; later sessions restore cloud. Legacy ambiguity requires explicit consolidation instead of a permanent ordinary source picker.

Validation:
- Cover zero/one/multiple local stores, old/missing/conflicting sections, exclusions, delayed sync/recovery, revocation tombstones, offline startup, sign-out/clear/restart and task/Notes source consistency. Assert no hidden enrollment, transfer, task command or game call.

Acceptance:
- New local sessions need no manual Workspace setup. Selected cloud sessions restore exact source/access through verified recovery; unavailable cloud cannot become a writable local fork. Existing records, drafts and original intents survive failures and migration prerequisites.

Documentation updates:
- Update technical.md, features.md, testing.md and source/settings contracts with the settings inventory, defaults and bootstrap states.

Risks:
- Sync metadata can be stale or excluded; missing preferences are not server revocation evidence. Final ordinary UI qualification remains a separate consumer unit.

tasks.title: Restore existing integration, Workspace and Notes sessions without enrollment
tasks.body:
Goal:
- Recover previously approved server access in new Companion sessions without repeating enrollment or creating permissions.

Current behavior:
- ChatGptIntegrationClient, WorkspaceCloudClient and NotesCloudClient keep tokens in memory. Revalidation calls enrollment, which rotates a single management token, rewrites consent and can create/reactivate a profile. Workspace/Notes connect can create/reactivate retained stores.

Desired behavior:
- Add authenticated existing-only recovery/status for active integration, Workspace and Notes consent. Distinguish missing, expired, revoked, deleted, unsupported-consent and unavailable states. Recovery cannot enroll, reactivate, replace stored credentials, rewrite consent, issue linking codes, expand grants or enable execution.
- Verify exact account, connection, consent version and access epochs before issuing bounded short-lived tab access; recheck authority before returning facts or access. Recovery preserves unrelated healthy tabs, while explicit management rotation/revocation retains documented effects. Return actual grants and executor observations separately from session availability.
- Define a versioned non-authorizing account-bound recovery descriptor and an explicit one-time existing-account bootstrap for legacy clients lacking the descriptor. Keep tokens out of generic sync, exports and diagnostics.

Touch:
- Auth vault/management/private identity boundary, Workspace/Notes session handlers, shared typed recovery DTOs and synthetic fixtures; additive migrations in the owning database only when required.

Discovery allowance:
- Inspect current session/consent tables and official platform security guidance. Choose a bounded transport preserving the existing vault, credential-storage policy and private identity boundary.

Out of scope:
- Initial enrollment, new OAuth grants, browser record transfer, gameplay, real account verification, publication and package upgrades.

Implementation constraints:
- Persisted preferences are not authorization. Ordinary sync without prior integration consent cannot upload credentials. Preserve quota, origin, no-store, expiry, redaction and server revocation guards; do not repurpose enrollment as recovery.

Questions and required clarifications:
- [Resolved - owner intent] Restore already approved settings across sessions. Missing permission requires the existing explicit approval path; recovery supplies no new consent.

Validation:
- Synthetic Auth/Workspace/Notes fixtures cover existing/missing/revoked/deleted profiles/stores, unsupported consent, token expiry, quota/outage, stale descriptors, account switches, concurrent tabs, revocation during recovery and delayed replies. Assert zero enrollment, consent rewrites, grant changes or executor transitions.

Acceptance:
- A fresh authorized client obtains access to the same retained stores and verified settings without enrollment. Invalid recovery changes no profile/store/consent. One tab recovery preserves another healthy tab; revocation blocks old and recovered access.

Documentation updates:
- Update integration/Workspace contracts, technical.md, features.md and testing.md with recovery, descriptor and legacy-bootstrap semantics. Research: skill-tree/history/processing/session-workspace-2026-10-30/research.md.

Risks:
- Existing enrollment is not a recovery shortcut. Synthetic acceptance cannot establish hosted, independent-account or physical-device behavior.
